scripts.typecheck: bun run check:toolchain && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: bun run check:toolchain && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src tests scripts eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run test:db
